definitions.gloss: seven-five meter; alternating 7- and 5-syllable rhythmic pattern
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese rhythmic pattern alternating phrases of 7 and 5 syllables. Fundamental to waka poetry, enka lyrics, folk songs, and many traditional chants. Feels natural and melodious to Japanese speakers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七五調|しちごちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{詠|よ}まれる→詠む：14186_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Waka poetry is composed in a seven-five rhythm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{演歌|えんか}→演歌：07082_enka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌詞|かし}→歌詞：13160_kashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七五調|しちごちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パターン→パターン：05456_pataan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The lyrics of enka songs frequently use the seven-five syllabic pattern.

examples.japanese: {七五調|しちごちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フレーズ→フレーズ：19999_fureezu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧、⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}り→残る：01187_nokoru⟧やすい⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Seven-five phrases have a pleasing rhythm and are easy to remember, so they are also used in advertising.

notes:
{七|しち} (seven) + ⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧ (five) + {調|ちょう} (rhythm, meter). One of the defining rhythmic structures of Japanese literature and music.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Waka poetry (including tanka) follows a 5-7-5-7-7 syllable pattern, while haiku uses 5-7-5. The broader 7-5 unit ({七五調|しちごちょう}) is also prominent in:
- ⟦{演歌|えんか}→演歌：07082_enka⟧ (enka) and folk song lyrics
- {祭|まつり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掛|か}け{声|こえ}: festival chants
- ⟦{早口|はやくち}→早口：04321_hayakuchi⟧ことば: tongue twisters
- Traditional advertising slogans

The reverse pattern {五七調|ごしちちょう} (5-7) also exists but is less common in modern contexts.
